The winds are caused by the rapid rotation of the planet, which has a day length of only about ten hours, and by the heat generated deep within the planet. The jet streams on Jupiter are similar to those on Earth, but they are much stronger and more stable. The banded appearance of the planet is due to the fact that the jet streams on either side of a cloud band move in opposite directions.
